items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update addresses multiple vulnerabilities rated critical, high, and medium, including arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system write, and security feature bypass. It includes a fix for CVE-2026-103849 (BlockStrap).

items.title: BlockStrap: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE)
items.summary: BlockStrap is a CVSS 10.0 Magento and Adobe Commerce flaw that allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution. Adobe fixed it in APSB26-153, but a manual patch is required, and new installations remain vulnerable.

items.title: PolyShell: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type leading to RCE
items.summary: This vulnerability, also known as PolyShell, allows an unrestricted file upload that can lead to arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user. Although patched in July 2026 (APSB26-73), CISA added it to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on October 27, 2026, due to active exploitation.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE)
items.summary: StyleSmuggler is a zero-day vulnerability (CVSS 10.0) that enables unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution by injecting malicious code into Magento's template system. Adobe released an emergency hotfix (APSB26-146) on September 7, 2026, and is aware of active exploitation in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source resolves a critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-75650) that could result in arbitrary code execution. Adobe is aware of this CVE being exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including several Cross-site Scripting (Stored XSS) and Incorrect Authorization flaws. Successful exploitation could result in security feature bypass and privilege escalation.

items.title: SessionReaper: Unauthenticated RCE and Customer Account Takeover
items.summary: SessionReaper is a critical (CVSS 9.1) flaw discovered in all versions of Adobe Commerce and Magento, allowing customer account takeover and unauthenticated remote code execution under certain conditions. Active exploitation was observed starting October 22, 2026, with PHP backdoors uploaded via the customer address form.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including CVE-2026-48356. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.
